We remark that the miracle that the Poisson deformations along π S 1 ( c ) as in Theorem A are unobstructed has been observed in [MPS20] in the context of complex log-symplectic manifolds. While the methods of [MPS20] heavily used the homotopy algebra techniques, such L ∞ -algebras, our proofs are elementary and our strategies are adopted from [MPS24] where deformations of q -symmetric algebras are studied.
